name: Census and demography
description: Population, age, sex, marital status, nationality, religion, housing and occupations.
coverage: 330 judicial districts in 1930; 328 in 1921; political estimates identified.

name: Elections
description: Valid votes for 1920, 1925, 1929 and 1935; selected party shares and 1935–1929 changes with crosswalk flags.
coverage: 326 districts shown in 1935 previews; 273 conservative KSČ changes.
source: Czech Statistical Office; project election crosswalk

name: Monthly and annual climate
description: Ten CRU variables, seasonal summaries, 1901–1928 baseline anomalies and station-support diagnostics.
source: CRU-TS v 4.10 / University of East Anglia

name: Terrain
description: District elevation, slope and terrain summaries from the archived digital elevation model.

name: Rivers and river access
description: Clipped river length and density; distances from interior points and a regular area grid; river-order and size proxies.
coverage: All 330 primary districts; 960 across four boundary layers.
status: Geographic context, not interwar discharge or navigability

name: Railways
description: Operating network length, density, electrification, chronology and distance to track; 1937 opening correction included.
source: Ondřej Bedrunka, Palacký University (2023); own aggregates
status: Historical reconstruction with known missing-source geometry

name: Land use
description: Eight categories plus total agricultural land, allocated hectares, shares and valid coverage.
coverage: 3, 840 district–date rows; historical district boundaries fixed.
status: Areal estimates; no interpolated 1930 land use

name: Soils
description: Clay, sand, silt, coarse fragments, pH and organic carbon; depth-specific and 0–30 cm weighted summaries.
coverage: 293 of 330 districts pass the conservative 90% texture-coverage filter.

name: Geology
description: Original geological legend categories, area composition, dominant units and overlap/coverage diagnostics.
coverage: 12, 239 district–legend composition rows across four layers.

name: Drainage basins
description: Level 6, 8 and 12 basin intersections, dominant basin shares and upstream network identifiers.

name: Mineral registers
description: Counts, source categories, present registered footprints and distances to mineral-deposit records.
coverage: All 330 primary districts; current B/D/P/R categories preserved.
status: Modern register, not evidence of active interwar mining

name: State borders
description: Distances to the external state boundary and inside/outside flags at five dated snapshots.

name: Gazetteer and spatial links
description: CZ_RETRO reference-locality links, rook/queen neighbours, shared boundaries and between-district distances.
coverage: Locality references are not a census of active 1930 municipalities.

name: Municipal reference series
description: Population and houses from fourteen censuses, kept as a separate reference table.
status: Separate geography; no unsupported district crosswalk
